newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Totta shares gain on price report.
newsitem.headline: Banco Totta shares gain on price report.

text.p: Shares in Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) were gaining just over one percent at 2,771 escudos per share after a newspaper report that the government had been recommended a price of 3,000 for the small stake it intends to sell, traders said.

The share, which was briefly suspended in the morning, rose to a high of 2,850 escudos before retreating on profit-taking. Traders said they did not expect the stock to break back above 2,800 on Friday because at that level sellers emerged.
